summary: Renders a multi-layer race information overlay. When dword_8ACF8C equals 0x7FFFFFFF (infinite/unset race distance) it renders primary text with a shadow pass at (a1+50, 10) in white; otherwise it formats and renders a lap-count line in yellow at (a1+215, 46). Always renders two secondary text layers with shadow at (a1+50, 50). Returns the final render result.

operations.description: Branch on dword_8ACF8C: equal to 0x7FFFFFFF selects the shadow+foreground primary text layout at (a1+50, 10); otherwise selects the lap-count layout at (a1+215, 46).
Format primary text into the 64-byte stack buffer via sub_49C8F0 for the shadow render pass.
Render the primary shadow pass: UITextRenderWithScale(buffer, a1 + 50, 10, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0).
Format primary text into the buffer via sub_49C960 for the foreground render pass.
Render the primary foreground pass: UITextRenderWithScale(buffer, a1 + 50, 10, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0).
Alternative branch: format lap-count text via sub_49C670 and render it in yellow: UITextRenderWithScale(buffer, a1 + 215, 46, 16776960, 2, 0, 0.75, 1.0).
Format secondary text field 1 via sub_49C700 and render it with shadow: UITextRenderWithScale(buffer, v1 + 50, 50, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0).
Format secondary text field 2 via sub_49C770 and render its foreground: UITextRenderWithScale(buffer, v1 + 50, 50, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0).
Return the result of the final UITextRenderWithScale call.
